title: Build missing Infinigen native terrain OcMesher libraries
objective: Build and verify the missing native Infinigen libraries required for real_geometry.gin: terrain/lib/cpu/sdf_from_mesh/sdf_from_mesh.so and OcMesher/ocmesher/lib/core.so.
instructions: Create a run directory under .control-tower/runs and launch a named tmux session/window immediately. Return attach command, exact command, log paths, and verification results.
Primary command to run inside tmux, teeing to logs: cd /home/yashturkar/Workspace/infinigen && source /home/yashturkar/miniconda3/etc/profile.d/conda.sh && conda activate infinigen && make terrain.

After make terrain, run: test -s /home/yashturkar/Workspace/infinigen/infinigen/terrain/lib/cpu/sdf_from_mesh/sdf_from_mesh.so && test -s /home/yashturkar/Workspace/infinigen/infinigen/OcMesher/ocmesher/lib/core.so && conda run -n infinigen python -c "from ctypes import CDLL; CDLL('/home/yashturkar/Workspace/infinigen/infinigen/terrain/lib/cpu/sdf_from_mesh/sdf_from_mesh.so'); CDLL('/home/yashturkar/Workspace/infinigen/infinigen/OcMesher/ocmesher/lib/core.so'); print('native ocmesher libs load')".

If make terrain fails, preserve the full log. If the two required libs are still missing, run the Scout fallback to build only those two libs: cd /home/yashturkar/Workspace/infinigen/infinigen/terrain && mkdir -p lib/cpu/sdf_from_mesh && g++ -O3 -c -fpic -fopenmp -o lib/cpu/sdf_from_mesh/sdf_from_mesh.o source/cpu/sdf_from_mesh/sdf_from_mesh.cpp && g++ -O3 -shared -fopenmp -o lib/cpu/sdf_from_mesh/sdf_from_mesh.so lib/cpu/sdf_from_mesh/sdf_from_mesh.o && cd /home/yashturkar/Workspace/infinigen/infinigen/OcMesher && bash install.sh. Then rerun the ctypes verification.
constraints: Do not edit product code, docs, or git.
expected_outputs: Required native libraries exist and ctypes-load, or a concrete compiler/dependency blocker with logs is reported.
definition_of_done: Result packet includes exact build command, attach command, whether full make terrain succeeded, whether fallback was needed, and ctypes verification output.
